# Suprabhat Kumar Portfolio

Suprabhat Kumar is a Senior Frontend Engineer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, frontend performance, Core Web Vitals, and accessibility.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://suprabhat-dev.com/): Professional overview, selected work, experience, services, recommendations, FAQs, and contact details.
- [About](https://suprabhat-dev.com/about/): Background and engineering philosophy.
- [Skills](https://suprabhat-dev.com/skills/): Frontend engineering skills.
- [Experience](https://suprabhat-dev.com/experience/): Professional experience.
- [Work](https://suprabhat-dev.com/work/): Selected projects and case studies.
- [Services](https://suprabhat-dev.com/services/): Available consulting and development services.
- [Contact](https://suprabhat-dev.com/contact/): Contact form and direct email information.
- [Blog](https://suprabhat-dev.com/blog/): English-language articles about frontend engineering.

## Locales

The homepage and primary portfolio pages are available in English, Spanish at `/es/`, and Arabic at `/ar/`. English blog articles currently have no localized equivalents; localized blog indexes are intentionally excluded from search indexing.

## Crawling

Use the canonical URLs above. Refer to [sitemap-index.xml](https://suprabhat-dev.com/sitemap-index.xml) for crawlable site URLs and [robots.txt](https://suprabhat-dev.com/robots.txt) for crawler directives.
